jenkins-cicd-pipeline.title: Jenkins CI/CD pipeline
jenkins-cicd-pipeline.shortDescription: A fully automated CI/CD and monitoring pipeline using Jenkins, AWS, and Prometheus for seamless deployments across environments.
jenkins-cicd-pipeline.fullDescription: Designed and implemented a production-grade CI/CD pipeline for Praaktisgo using Jenkins and AWS. The system automates builds, testing, and deployments across dev and prod environments with CodeDeploy integration. Custom AMIs were built for Jenkins agents with preinstalled tools (JDK, Ant, Git, AWS CLI), and the pipeline dynamically provisions build agents to compile and deploy applications. Build artifacts are uploaded to S3 and deployed via AWS CodeDeploy, while post-build scripts send changelogs and build status updates to a Telegram group. Prometheus monitors the Jenkins controller and agents through node_exporter, providing real-time visibility into resource usage and performance metrics.
jenkins-cicd-pipeline.summary: An automated build, test and deploy pipeline on Jenkins and AWS, with Prometheus watching the build infrastructure.
points: Automates builds, tests and deployments across dev and prod, with AWS CodeDeploy handling the rollout.
Jenkins agents run on custom AMIs with the build tools preinstalled (JDK, Ant, Git, AWS CLI), and the pipeline provisions agents on demand.
Build artifacts go to S3 and are deployed with CodeDeploy.
Post-build scripts send changelogs and build status to a Telegram group.
Prometheus and node_exporter track resource usage on the Jenkins controller and agents.

hikcentral-remote-device-integration.title: HikGateway integration
hikcentral-remote-device-integration.shortDescription: Developed a secure and scalable remote device integration platform using HikGateway (Device Gateway) to enable Hikvision devices to connect to cloud infrastructure via outbound ISUP communication. Devices deployed behind NAT and firewalls initiate persistent, encrypted ISUP connections over the public Internet to a cloud-hosted HikGateway instance, eliminating the need for static IP addresses or inbound network exposure at customer sites. HikGateway acts as the centralized control plane, managing device registration, session lifecycle, status monitoring, and event handling. All device operations and third-party integrations are performed through HikGateway’s ISAPI interfaces over HTTPS, allowing external backend services to securely manage devices, retrieve events, and perform control actions without direct device access. The architecture emphasizes outbound-only connectivity, TLS-encrypted transport, strict network isolation, and API-driven integration, making it suitable for large-scale, multi-tenant deployments of Hikvision ISUP-enabled devices.
hikcentral-remote-device-integration.summary: A remote-device platform that lets Hikvision devices behind NAT and firewalls connect to the cloud, with no inbound exposure at customer sites.
points: Devices open persistent, encrypted outbound ISUP connections to a cloud-hosted HikGateway, so customer sites need no static IP and no inbound ports.
HikGateway is the control plane: it handles device registration, session lifecycle, status monitoring and events.
Backend services manage devices, read events and send control commands through HikGateway's ISAPI interfaces over HTTPS, without touching the devices directly.
The design is outbound-only, TLS-encrypted, network-isolated and API-driven, which suits large multi-tenant deployments.

comprehensive-monitoring-stack.title: Monitoring stack
comprehensive-monitoring-stack.shortDescription: A complete observability solution with Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and Alertmanager providing full-stack monitoring, logging, and alerting for infrastructure and applications.
comprehensive-monitoring-stack.fullDescription: Designed and implemented a production-grade monitoring and observability stack for KPI's infrastructure and applications. The solution provides comprehensive visibility across the entire technology stack through multiple specialized exporters and collectors. Prometheus serves as the central metrics collection and storage system, scraping metrics from node_exporter (system metrics), jmx_exporter (Java application metrics), cAdvisor (container metrics), and a custom exporter for application-specific metrics. Grafana provides rich visualization dashboards for infrastructure health, application performance, and business metrics. Loki aggregates logs from all services, with Promtail collecting and forwarding log data from various sources. Alertmanager handles alert routing and deduplication, sending critical notifications directly to Telegram for real-time incident response. The entire stack is containerized and orchestrated for high availability and scalability, ensuring reliable monitoring even during infrastructure incidents.
comprehensive-monitoring-stack.summary: A central observability stack for metrics, logs and alerts across KPI's infrastructure and applications.
points: Prometheus collects metrics from node_exporter (system), jmx_exporter (Java), cAdvisor (containers) and a custom exporter for application metrics.
Grafana dashboards cover infrastructure health, application performance and business metrics.
Loki aggregates logs from every service, with Promtail collecting and forwarding them.
Alertmanager routes and deduplicates alerts and sends critical ones to Telegram.
The whole stack runs in containers and is built for high availability.

savethis4me-telegram-bot.title: SaveThis4Me Telegram bot
savethis4me-telegram-bot.shortDescription: A Telegram bot that saves videos and posts from Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, X, Reddit and Pinterest straight into your chat. Paste a link, or share from Instagram, and the media arrives in seconds.
savethis4me-telegram-bot.fullDescription: SaveThis4Me is a public Telegram bot that relays social media content into Telegram chats. It started as an invite-only hobby project for Instagram Reels and Stories and was later rebuilt from scratch as an open bot anyone can use. Users paste a link from Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, X, Reddit or Pinterest and get the media back as a native Telegram video, photo or album. Instagram users can also bind their account and share posts to the @savethis4me relay account right from the Instagram app, delivered to the bot through signed Meta webhooks. YouTube links open a quality picker with estimated file sizes and an audio-only option, and are processed by a background job queue with live progress and per-user limits. Built-in media tools recognize songs with Shazam, convert videos into round video notes and extract voice notes. The bot is written in Python with python-telegram-bot and FastAPI, uses yt-dlp, gallery-dl and FFmpeg to fetch and normalize media, stores users, cached media and engagement metrics in PostgreSQL, and runs in Docker with per-domain concurrency limits and rate limiting.
savethis4me-telegram-bot.summary: A public Telegram bot that saves videos and posts from Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, X, Reddit and Pinterest into your chat.
points: Paste a link and get the media back as a native Telegram video, photo or album.
Instagram users can bind their account and share posts to the @savethis4me relay account from the Instagram app, delivered through signed Meta webhooks.
YouTube links open a quality picker with estimated file sizes and an audio-only option, and downloads run in a background job queue with live progress and per-user limits.
Built-in tools recognize songs with Shazam, turn videos into round video notes and extract voice notes.

Written in Python with python-telegram-bot and FastAPI, using yt-dlp, gallery-dl and FFmpeg; users, cached media and metrics live in PostgreSQL, and everything runs in Docker with per-domain concurrency limits and rate limiting.
It began as an invite-only hobby project for Instagram Reels and Stories and was rebuilt from scratch as an open bot.
